name: text-highlighter
title: Text Highlighter
description: A highlight that draws behind inline text from four directions: in view, on hover or focus, on mount, or on command. Solid, marker, underline, or gradient.

props.name: as
props.description: The element to render. Keep it inline, such as span, strong, or mark.

props.name: trigger
props.description: view draws when the text scrolls into view, hover follows hover and keyboard focus of the closest link or button, auto draws on mount, manual follows active.

props.name: direction
props.description: Where the highlight grows from: left to right, right to left, top to bottom, or bottom to top.

props.name: variant
props.description: solid fills the line, marker covers the lower 60% like a highlighter pen, underline draws a thick bar under the text, gradient blends two tokens.

props.name: color
props.description: Token used for the highlight, mixed with transparency so the text stays readable.

props.name: once
props.description: trigger view: draw once, or clear again when the text leaves the viewport.

props.name: threshold
props.description: trigger view: how much of the text must be visible, from 0 to 1.

props.name: duration
props.description: Milliseconds the highlight takes to draw.

props.name: delay
props.description: Milliseconds to wait before drawing. Use rising delays to highlight a paragraph in order.

a11y: The text stays plain text; the highlight is a background image and is not announced.
Text on the highlight uses the ink token, which keeps AA contrast in light and dark themes.
trigger hover also responds to keyboard focus on the closest link, button, or focusable element.
With reduced motion, view and auto highlights are shown at once and every change happens without a transition.

ai.whenToUse: Key phrases in articles, hero headings, and checklists that should draw the eye as they scroll in or on interaction.
rules: Highlight a few short phrases, not whole paragraphs
Use rising delay values to highlight phrases in reading order
Use trigger hover inside a link or button so keyboard focus works too
React exposes animate(direction) and reset() through ref, Vue through a template ref, Blade through the markas-highlight and markas-highlight-reset window events

id.description: Sorotan di balik teks inline yang tergambar dari empat arah: saat masuk layar, hover atau fokus, mount, atau perintah. Solid, stabilo, garis bawah, gradien.

props.as: Elemen yang dirender. Tetap inline, misalnya span, strong, atau mark.
props.trigger: view menggambar saat teks masuk layar, hover mengikuti hover dan fokus keyboard pada link atau tombol terdekat, auto menggambar saat mount, manual mengikuti active.
props.direction: Arah tumbuh sorotan: kiri ke kanan, kanan ke kiri, atas ke bawah, atau bawah ke atas.
props.variant: solid mengisi baris, marker menutup 60% bagian bawah seperti stabilo, underline menggambar garis tebal di bawah teks, gradient memadukan dua token.
props.color: Token warna sorotan, dicampur transparansi agar teks tetap terbaca.
props.once: trigger view: gambar sekali, atau hapus lagi saat teks keluar layar.
props.threshold: trigger view: seberapa banyak teks harus terlihat, dari 0 sampai 1.
props.duration: Milidetik yang dibutuhkan sorotan untuk tergambar.
props.delay: Milidetik menunggu sebelum menggambar. Pakai delay bertingkat untuk menyorot paragraf berurutan.

a11y: Teks tetap teks biasa; sorotan adalah gambar latar dan tidak diumumkan.
Teks di atas sorotan memakai token ink sehingga kontras AA terjaga di tema terang dan gelap.
trigger hover juga merespons fokus keyboard pada link, tombol, atau elemen fokus terdekat.
Dengan reduced motion, sorotan view dan auto langsung tampil dan setiap perubahan terjadi tanpa transisi.

ai.whenToUse: Frasa kunci di artikel, judul hero, dan checklist yang perlu menarik mata saat masuk layar atau saat interaksi.
rules: Sorot beberapa frasa pendek, bukan seluruh paragraf
Pakai delay bertingkat untuk menyorot frasa sesuai urutan baca
Pakai trigger hover di dalam link atau tombol agar fokus keyboard juga bekerja
React mengekspos animate(direction) dan reset() lewat ref, Vue lewat template ref, Blade lewat event window markas-highlight dan markas-highlight-reset
